## Sample Characteristics

### Outcome prevalence

```{r}
#| label: outcome-prevalence
#| collapse: true

df |>
  count(diabetes) |>
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))
```

### Table 1 — sample characteristics by diabetes status

```{r}
#| label: table-one

df |>
  select(
    diabetes,
    age_group, sex, race_ethnicity, education, income_group,
    bmi_category, physically_active, smoking_status,
    heavy_drinker, has_provider, mental_health_days
  ) |>
  mutate(diabetes = factor(diabetes, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No diabetes", "Diabetes"))) |>
  tbl_summary(
    by      = diabetes,
    missing = "no"
  ) |>
  add_p() |>
  add_overall() |>
  bold_p(t = 0.05) |>
  bold_labels()
```

## Outcome Prevalence by Subgroup

```{r}
#| label: prevalence-by-subgroup
#| fig-cap: "Crude diabetes prevalence by key predictor categories"
#| fig-height: 10

# Categorical predictors only
cat_vars <- c("age_group", "sex", "race_ethnicity", "education",
              "income_group", "bmi_category", "smoking_status",
              "mental_health_days")

prev_data <- purrr::map_dfr(cat_vars, function(v) {
  df |>
    filter(!is.na(.data[[v]])) |>
    group_by(variable = v, level = .data[[v]]) |>
    summarise(
      n        = n(),
      cases    = sum(diabetes),
      prev_pct = mean(diabetes) * 100,
      .groups  = "drop"
    )
})

ggplot(prev_data, aes(x = prev_pct, y = reorder(level, prev_pct), fill = variable)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(prev_pct, 1), "%")),
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_epi() +
  labs(x = "Diabetes prevalence (%)", y = NULL,
       title = "Crude diabetes prevalence by predictor category") +
  xlim(0, max(prev_data$prev_pct) * 1.2)
```

## Unadjusted Associations

```{r}
#| label: uvregression

df |>
  mutate(
    diabetes          = factor(diabetes, levels = c(0, 1)),
    age_group         = factor(age_group,
                               levels = c("18-34", "35-44", "45-54", "55-64", "65-74", "75+")),
    sex               = factor(sex, levels = c("Male", "Female")),
    race_ethnicity    = factor(race_ethnicity, levels = c("NH White", "NH Black", "NH AIAN",
                                                          "NH Asian", "NH NHOPI",
                                                          "NH Other/Multiracial",
                                                          "Hispanic", "NH Other")),
    education         = factor(education,
                               levels = c("Graduated college", "Some college",
                                          "Graduated HS", "Did not graduate HS")),
    income_group      = factor(income_group,
                               levels = c(">$100k", "$50k-$100k", "$35k-$50k",
                                          "$25k-$35k", "$15k-$25k", "<$15k")),
    bmi_category      = factor(bmi_category,
                               levels = c("Normal", "Underweight", "Overweight", "Obese")),
    smoking_status    = factor(smoking_status,
                               levels = c("Never", "Former", "Current (some days)", "Current (daily)")),
    mental_health_days = factor(mental_health_days,
                                levels = c("0 days", "1-13 days", "14+ days"))
  ) |>
  select(
    diabetes,
    age_group, sex, race_ethnicity, education, income_group,
    bmi_category, physically_active, smoking_status,
    heavy_drinker, has_provider, mental_health_days
  ) |>
  tbl_uvregression(
    method       = glm,
    y            = diabetes,
    method.args  = list(family = binomial),
    exponentiate = TRUE,
    estimate_fun = \(x) style_sigfig(x, digits = 3)
  ) |>
  bold_p(t = 0.05) |>
  bold_labels()
```
